tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: List every jurisdiction and data kind this service covers, with the data_as_of date for each. Free.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Check whether a jurisdiction and data kind is covered before paying for a query. Free. Input: jurisdiction (name or slug), optional data_kind.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: List every tool and its price per call in USDC. Free.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create a prepaid API key. The key is shown once; store it in a secret store. Free.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List watches for an owner token returned when the watch was created. Free.

tools.name: cancel_watch
tools.description: Cancel a watch using its id and owner token. Free.

tools.name: get_label_rate
tools.description: US EPA pesticide product lookup by EPA registration number (e.g. 66551-1). Returns today: product name and registration status, signal word, restricted-use flag, formulation, active ingredients, and label PDF file names with acceptance dates. The application rate, REI and PPE numbers are printed ins

tools.name: get_zoning
tools.description: Cited zoning rules for a covered rural US jurisdiction: district names, setbacks, height, lot area/width, density and coverage from published code sections. Pass district (or zone) or latitude/longitude; with only a jurisdiction you get the available districts and fields. Unpublished fields are UNKN

tools.description: Whether a named land use is permitted, conditional or prohibited in a covered jurisdiction's published zoning table, with the exact table row and page citation. Verified against official sources and cited to the page; a fully UNKNOWN answer is never charged. Per-jurisdiction data dates: see check_coverage.

tools.name: topup_credits
